name: Form fields
summary: A short form of one to eight fields (text, number, choice, date or switch) with hints, checks as you leave a field, and Continue and Cancel buttons.
use: when the assistant needs a few details it cannot guess, such as a delivery change, a request or a problem report
a11y: Each control sits inside its label; hints and error messages are linked with aria-describedby, a wrong field gets aria-invalid, and Continue moves focus to the first field to fix. Toggles are switches (role=switch).

use_when: two to eight details the person must give before the assistant can act, each a short text, a number, a choice from a list, a date or a yes or no
avoid_when: one choice from a few answers: use quick-replies
picking an appointment time: use time-slots
signing in or anything with a password: use sign-in-form, and never ask for a password in a generated form
confirming an action that pays, sends or deletes: use approval-prompt after the form

parts.name: intro
parts.what: one sentence of context, such as a deadline

parts.name: fields
parts.what: one field: label, control, hint and error

parts.name: label
parts.what: the field's name; 'Optional' is added when it is not required

parts.name: control
parts.what: the native input chosen by kind: text, number, select or date, or a switch for toggle

parts.name: hint
parts.what: one line that helps fill it in

parts.name: error
parts.what: what to fix, written by the component's own check

parts.name: submit
parts.what: sends the answers to the assistant once every field passes; effect none, because the form only collects details: anything it then books, pays or sends is confirmed in its own approval step

empty.how: a form with no fields is not shown; ask in text instead

loading.how: keep the labels and show empty controls at their full height

error.how: a missing required value or a number out of range shows a message under the field, marks it aria-invalid and moves focus to the first one on Continue

disabled.how: a field the person may not change is disabled and greyed; its value stays readable

overflow.how: fields stack; on a phone the two buttons stack full width with Continue on top

long_text.how: labels, hints and errors wrap; values scroll inside their control

keyboard: Tab moves through the fields, then Cancel and Continue
Space turns a switch on or off; arrow keys move through a select's options
Enter in a text field presses Continue, which checks every field first
